$comment: Single source of truth for a stable-release cycle. Edit this, then run the tools in src/ and bundles/v{version}. See RELEASE_PROCEDURE.md and the vc-stable-release skill. To cut the NEXT stable: bump version/prevVersion, set the new platformVersion/themeVersion, and update jiraTicket/branch. Paths are this machine's local clones.
$sandbox: Isolation sandbox (setup-sandbox.ps1): <sandboxRoot>/src holds fresh clones that the release modifies (monorepoRoot/localNugetPath are repointed here), <sandboxRoot>/runtime holds a deployed platform seeded from the PREVIOUS stable for per-wave health probing. NOTE: Stable 16 uses the CI-driven PR-gate workflow (GitHub Actions as quality gate) per release_plan.md; the sandbox/local-nuget/local-runtime steps are not used this cycle.
